data.narrative:
Bedrock Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Joselyn Lai, Silviu Livescu, and Joel Wishkovsky. The target sector includes 9 comparable private companies (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen among them) and 1 public peer, though no private comparables share identical stage and valuation characteristics sufficient for median-based triangulation.

The valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the only applicable approach given data constraints. Using the company's $15M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, this method implies a $30M valuation. The peer-median approach was not applicable; while 9 same-sector peers exist, none met the filters for adjacent-stage or similar-tier comparability, rendering a cross-peer median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $34M, with a median of $30M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the stage-progression multiplier in frontier energy markets, where capital intensity and development timelines may diverge from median VC patterns. The narrow methodology base and absence of tightly comparable private transactions at this stage represent material constraints on precision.
